purpose: Tests whether Claude Code, seeing only this skill's name and description (not its body), correctly decides to consult it for in-scope requests and correctly leaves it alone for out-of-scope ones — including near-misses that deliberately overlap with adjacent OwnerRez skills (rate-setting, listing content, photo captions, Rezzy guest-messaging directives) and other platforms.

split.note: train informs description revisions; test is held out and only used to score the final description, to avoid overfitting to the exact tested phrasings.
